headline: A new law lets the Little Rock, Arkansas post office named after Scipio A. Jones display a portrait of him in its lobby.
what_it_does: The law allows the postmaster of the Scipio A. Jones Post Office in Little Rock, Arkansas, to accept a portrait of Scipio A. Jones painted by artist Wade Hampton. The postmaster may display it in the post office lobby. It is a permission measure about a single building and does not create new rules for the public.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on December 3, 2020.
